summary: Fast lightweight bug-fix command for known-diagnosis cases: delegated z-preflight.sh/z-teardown.sh lifecycle ceremony, bundled two-LLM light-fix consult, inline implementation, mandatory Codex review, single FIX.md artifact, ~15 min target.

entry_points.summary: Top-level slash command; fast bug-fix path for known-diagnosis cases
Slug derivation (2-step: unconditional collision check then resolver gate skip/prefill/ask/halt), delegated z-preflight.sh ceremony, fix_run_start log
Single delegated call owning resolve/session-id/RUN-stamp/claim/register/run-brief-init/run_start/kernel-resolve, fixed order; z-fix claims (WRITE command)
z-fix's deviations from the canonical /z-plan Setup step 2 writer instance
Non-skippable wrong-tool gate; AskUserQuestion; exits to /z-debug if no hypothesis
Problem capture + doc-fetcher dispatch + auto-bail check
Single key decision; bail to /z-plan if >2 non-obvious decisions
Bundled light-fix consult: Gemini + Codex in parallel, cause-explains-symptoms framing; kernel_path injected when KERNEL_PATH non-empty
Synthesize; one-reason-wrong check; surface cross-LLM disagreement
Approve/modify/abandon gate (conversational prose reply, not AskUserQuestion popup); shortcuts need separate explicit approval
Write FIX.md (single artifact, status=approved not yet shipped)
Inline implementation by orchestrator; no implementer subagent; hard limit >7 files
Codex review (sole gate, non-negotiable); retry once on blockers; REVIEW_CYCLES counter
Finalize: FIX.md status=shipped, Run Brief finalize (fragment include), fix_run_end log, delegated z-teardown.sh, /z-maintain-docs hint
Shared halt-finalize block for every terminal halt after z-preflight.sh succeeds; delegates teardown to z-teardown.sh --status aborted
Doctrine: check git branch -r --contains before any reset/amend/rebase on upstream branch

invariants: Phase 0 (wrong-tool gate) is non-skippable, even when $ARGUMENTS is non-empty
A symptom description alone is not a hypothesis; Phase 0 rejects it
Codex review (Phase 8) is always run and is the sole review gate — fix mode never skips it and there is no advisory/eval-reviewer arm
light-fix consult is always bundled (Gemini + Codex in parallel), never sequential or single-provider
Consult framing is 'does this cause explain all symptoms?', not 'what is the best fix?'
Cross-LLM disagreement is always surfaced to the user; never silently resolved
Implementation is inline on the orchestrator main thread; implementer subagent is never spawned
Auto-bail on >5 candidate files or >2 non-obvious decisions is non-negotiable without explicit user override
Mid-implementation scope growth triggers immediate halt; orchestrator does not continue or offer alternatives
FIX.md is the sole planning artifact; SPEC.md, PLAN.md, TASKS.md are never generated
/z-mr-review is never auto-triggered from /z-fix
Before any git reset/amend/rebase on upstream-tracking branch: run git branch -r --contains <sha>; STOP if upstream reachable
PushNotification calls at Phase 5 and Phase 10 are gated on notify.level from config; when notify.level=off no notifications are sent
Slug derivation runs unconditional collision check first; resolver (workflow.slug_confirm) only governs the soft confirmation gate after collision check passes

Setup step 2 delegates resolve/session-id/RUN-stamp/claim/register/run-brief-init/run_start/kernel-resolve to a single scripts/z-preflight.sh call, in that fixed order (contract: script header; LEDGER T005)
/z-fix is a WRITE command: it claims via z-preflight.sh by default (no --no-claim)
PREFLIGHT_RC must be captured BEFORE eval of the preflight script's stdout — reading $? after eval loses the script's exit-code contract
Pre-preflight halts (e.g. Setup step 1 workflow.slug_confirm=halt) are a plain exit 0 — nothing is registered yet, so z-teardown.sh and the Run Brief halt-finalize block are NOT invoked
Every terminal halt after z-preflight.sh succeeds (RUN exported) funnels through the same Run Brief halt-finalize procedure — never a bespoke cleanup path (SKILL-STYLE.md §2)
Phase 10 finalize and the halt-finalize path both delegate teardown (claim release, deregister, generic run_end) to scripts/z-teardown.sh instead of manual cleanup

kernel_path is injected as a line into both Phase 3 consultant prompts only when KERNEL_PATH (from preflight kernel-resolve) is non-empty; omitted otherwise so each agent's static fallback self-resolves

Phase 5 approval is conversational prose, not an AskUserQuestion popup; AskUserQuestion is reserved for RUNTIME-GATE-marked call sites: Setup step 1 halt header, Phase 0 (control-flow fork), Phase 5 shortcut approval, Phase 8 second-failure (risk), Phase 9 (decision)
Run Brief is initialised as part of the Setup step 2 z-preflight.sh call with profile=full and artifact=FIX.md; when FIX.md is missing the shared finalize fragment auto-downgrades to lite mode
gotchas: Hard implementation file limit is >7 (halt regardless); auto-bail threshold is >5 (escalate before starting)
REVIEW_CYCLES counter is initialized at Setup step 5, not at Phase 8
Post-mortem default flips from skip to suggest when REVIEW_CYCLES > 1
doc-fetcher is dispatched only if docs/llm/INDEX.json exists; Explore subagent is never spawned in fix mode
Shortcuts flagged by either consultant require separate explicit approval at Phase 5; default is the robust solution
phase1-context.md is a temporary scratch file under archive/$RUN/; its content migrates to FIX.md sections
FIX.md 'Docs touched' field drives the post-fix /z-maintain-docs suggestion and the Run Brief $NEXT_JSON value
Plan directory collision: if slug already exists, user is asked before overwriting (unconditional check; resolver cannot bypass it)
Force-push to main requires per-incident user authorization with list of overwritten commits and content-equivalence demonstration
Notification control point is notify.level in config (docs/human/config.md), not the Z_HARNESS_NOTIFY env var

workflow.slug_confirm resolver returns one of four results: skip/prefill/ask/halt; halt is distinct from error (falls through to ask) and skip (silently continues), and — unlike the other three — occurs BEFORE z-preflight.sh runs

Setup step 1 halt exits with code 0 and logs fix_halt event before z-preflight.sh ever runs; no claim was taken, no Run Brief was initialized, so z-teardown.sh and Run Brief halt-finalize are skipped entirely for this path

There is no personas.review_eval / advisory eval-reviewer arm in /z-fix's current Phase 8 — it was present in a prior doc snapshot but is absent from the current source; Phase 8 has exactly one reviewer dispatch (Codex, base gate)

The RUNTIME-GATE closing conformance table pattern is retired for rewritten skills (SKILL-STYLE.md §1); each gated call site now carries its own inline RUNTIME-GATE comment as the single source of truth

Source file is skills/z-fix/SKILL.md (commands/ dir retired during the earlier z-harness-portability migration); the skill-overhaul-phase1 rewrite (426->431 lines) added the full delegated z-preflight.sh/z-teardown.sh lifecycle ceremony that previously did not exist in this file at all — all entry_point line numbers refreshed against this 431-line state as of 2026-07-11
